title: studio: unusable below tablet width, and the flow canvas does not fit-to-view on resize
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## Maintainer quick-read

Studio is unusable below tablet width and the flow canvas does not refit on resize. Support narrow screens, or say "best on desktop"?

## Seen

- 390 px: the Automations canvas is squeezed to ~50 px beside a fixed ~290 px Configuration panel; the pillar bar scrolls sideways.
- 1024 px: the flow canvas keeps its old viewport, clipping the Start/End cards at the left edge; the empty Configuration panel still reserves its width.

## Options

- **A** — inspector becomes a drawer below ~1100 px, canvas fit-to-view on resize, a desktop hint on phones.
- **B** — fit-to-view only.
- **C** — status quo.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *studio responsive mobile flow canvas fit to view resize*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#2285 (closed) — closed 2026-07-05 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#2291): listed 'Studio has no responsive/mobile layout' and 'fit view doesn't fill'; this card = residual/regression
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: studio responsive mobile · flow canvas fit to view resize · inspector drawer narrow
